en.topic_title: No plans to drop dog-friendly restaurant policy despite online backlash, Hong Kong minister says
en.topic_summary:
There are no plans to halt a new policy allowing dogs to enter permitted Hong Kong restaurants and cafes, a minister has said amid online backlash.



Pet dogs inside Wan Land Mori cafe in Kowloon City on July 12, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Tse Chin-wan, the environment and ecology minister, said on NowTV on Sunday the policy is still in “teething stage,” which came into effect on July 9.
